propositions: Dependabot PR #125 proposes bumping zizmor 1.28.0→1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0, but the mcp bump breaks five import paths that depend on removed mcp.server modules in v2.0
The zizmor 1.29.0 bump is safe and should land; the mcp 2.0 migration is structural work already tracked under ticket 732b and should be excluded from this change
The pyproject.toml dev group must pin zizmor exactly at 1.29.0 (not a floor) for local-to-CI parity in linting, and mcp must remain constrained <2 to keep resolver at 1.29.0

After editing pyproject.toml, uv.lock must be regenerated with 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor' to match CI's gate ('uv lock --check') and to reproduce dependabot's intent exactly without extra revision or marker churn
The change must pass make lint (with zizmor 1.29.0 on release.yml), make typecheck, the test suite, and be merged to main via Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before closing PR #125
The mcp 2.0 half of PR #125 must not land in this change; it remains deferred to ticket 732b-51df-acf2-477b
